payload.claim: The dockerfile path for the base image, "images/cell-base.python.Dockerfile", is restated as a string literal in `_IMAGE_SOURCES` instead of being derived from `image.BASE_DOCKERFILE` (`saffron/repos/image.py:19`), which already holds this exact path relative to `_SAFFRON_ROOT`. The preceding comment at lines 397-398 claims the tuple is "read from `proxy.py` and `image.py` so a renamed tag cannot drift", but only the tag half of each pair is actually read from those modules; the dockerfile half is a second, independent copy of a value one module already owns, so a rename of that file would silently desync the two.
